name: Longer Ray5 20W
tagline: 20W Compact fixed-focus diode: simple desk engraver for small projects
tldr: Longer Ray5 20W is the 20W SKU on the Longer longer ray5 line. Longer's compact Ray5 20W diode engraver: verify you are buying the 20W SKU, not the 5W, 10W, or 40W Ray5 listings. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $400 to $449 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Cuts a 3 mm basswood square in ~9–15 min in our benchmarks
Fills at ~16–36 mm/s, three times the speed of the entry Ray5
Wide choice of kits on Longer's store, from $399.99 basic to large-format expansion
cons: Wider 0.08 × 0.10 mm spot than the finest Ray5, per Longer
Slightly smaller working area: 400 × 365 mm according to Longer
Longer's 15 mm one-pass rating is optimistic next to our cut benchmark
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W SKU on Longer Ray5. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Ray5 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU: clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame: glasses and exhaust required. Upgrade path to 40W if cutting takes over. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.

faq.question: Is 15 mm in one pass realistic on the Ray5 20W?
faq.answer: Longer rates the 20W for 15 mm basswood in one pass and up to 35 mm acrylic, figures that assume ideal settings. In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 9–15 min at 2–3 mm/s; around 8 mm basswood in several passes is a realistic everyday limit.

faq.question: Which Ray5 20W kit should I buy?
faq.answer: On Longer's store in October 2026: Basic set $399.99, Cutting kit with air assist and honeycomb $459.99, All-in-One Studio kit with rotary and camera $619.99, Large Format Expansion kit $779.99. For cutting, the $60 step to the Cutting kit is the one that pays off first.

faq.question: Ray5 20W or Ray5 40W?
faq.answer: The 40W is a redesigned machine: 8-beam compression, 15 mm industrial rail and 24,000 mm/min, and it cuts our 3 mm square in about 6–10 min. Longer's store listed it at $679.99 against $399.99 for this 20W basic set (October 2026). Keep the 20W for mixed engraving and light cutting.

standoutFeatures.title: Engraving and light cutting
standoutFeatures.body: 3 mm basswood squares in about 9–15 min in our benchmarks, with fills around 16–36 mm/s.

standoutFeatures.title: Large-format kit
standoutFeatures.body: Longer sells a Large Format Expansion kit for this version ($779.99 in October 2026) for bigger panels.
